verdict.rationale: Media encode/decode engines and creator-app or ISV-certified driver support are a fair question for any GPU, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only AI training/inference, system management, NVLink and virtualization. Nothing mentions AV1/HEVC encoders, media engines, creator-app acceleration or ISV-certified drivers.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it
